description: This file is a TypeScript module for configuring network proxy settings within a VS Code extension, including proxy initialization, environment variable management, and patching fetch for debugging purposes.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the proxy configuration state, including whether the proxy is enabled, server URL, TLS insecurity, and debug mode status.

methods.name: initializeNetworkProxy
methods.description: Initializes the network proxy module with the VS Code extension context, setting up configuration change listeners and applying proxy settings if enabled.

methods.name: getProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current proxy configuration based on VS Code settings and extension mode.

methods.name: isProxyEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if the proxy is enabled and active in debug mode.

methods.name: isDebugMode
methods.description: Returns true if the extension is running in debug/development mode.
